snippet.title: Empyrion Galactic Survival - v1.10: Summer Update
snippet.description:
Main features
- Defense drones now available for player structures and vessels with the new Drone Bay
- The hoverbike replaces the motorbike! 
- We added 23 new block shapes for survival and creative modes
- Two elemental blocks were added for creative mode: Water and lava.
- Blueprint parts collection toolset (creative mode) 
- Device access can now be set according based on player role in a player faction 
- Visual improvement of ground textures 
- Visual improvement of the ocean planet and various suns
- Added several new player-submitted faction homeworlds 
- Over 300 new bases and ships added 
- Each starting map now has a 5-part mission arc (25 missions to play in total) 
- Game start on Ningues, Masperon and Skillon beefed up (no more dropping of escape pods) 
- Combat soundtrack now starts when a fight begins.

Important Gameplay Notes:
- Mass/volume & CPU & block limits are active by default when you start a new game.
- Blueprint factory requires all devices in a blueprint to be unlocked in the Techtree.

Note: You can change the above settings in the Difficulty menu when starting a new game.

Full details on the new features, additions, and changes can be found over here: https://www.empyriononline.com.
---------
How To videos: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4cKhWEY4IRirG9ftO1VG5rajwj4aWEh8
---------
Empyrion - Galactic Survival is a 3D open world, space survival adventure in which you can fly across space and land on planets. Build, explore, fight and survive in a hostile galaxy full of hidden dangers. The game uniquely combines elements from space simulations, construction games, survival games and ego-shooters. The game is currently under development by Eleon Game Studios.
